content: छेदः [छिद् भावे घञ् अच् वा] .²1 Cutting, felling down, breaking down, dividing; अभिज्ञाश्छेदपातानां क्रियन्ते नन्दनद्रुमाः <ls>Ku. 2. 41</ls>; छेदो दंशस्य दाहो वा <ls>M. 4. 4</ls>; <ls>R. 14. 1</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 270</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">370</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 223</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">240</ls>. .²2 Solving, removing, dissipating, clearing; as in संशयच्छेद. .²3 Destruction, interruption; निद्राच्छेदाभिताम्रा <ls>Mu. 3. 21</ls>. .²4 Cessation, end, termination, disappearance as in घर्मच्छेद <ls>Ś. 2. 5</ls>. .²5 A distinguishing mark. .²6 A cut, an incision, cleft. .²7 Deprivation, want, deficiency. .²8 Failure; सन्ततिच्छेद <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. .²9 A piece, bit, cut, fragment, section; बिसकिसलयच्छेदपाथेयवन्तः <ls>Me. 11</ls>, <ls n="Me.">59</ls>; अभिनवकरिदन्तच्छेदपाण्डुः कपोलः <ls>Māl. 1. 22</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 4</ls>; <ls>Ś. 3. 6</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 100</ls>. .²10 (In <ab>math.</ab>) A divisor, the denominator of a fraction.
